mission: Make local publish and verify predictable under agent fan-out by extending the existing QualityScheduler: lane or package admission units with measured weights, final-check and agent-shell heavy work admitted, a bounded in-publish advisory coverage ratchet, hosted Test Unit partitions run locally in shadow, readiness monitors that back off and reuse one live job per PR, and time-to-certainty's C4.2 enforcement and wave re-seed re-homed here.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

stopConditions: Required source files are missing or materially contradictory.
Any spend: purchases, paid services, quota top-ups or plan changes need the operator.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
statusNote: P0 closed 2026-11-10 with the baseline checkpoint (decisions/2026-11-10-p0-baseline.md); P1 in progress: slice 1, the merged-preview dormancy note (PERIL-13), and slice 2, the scheduler quarantine summary line and 7-day archive in the reap pass (PERIL-10), landed; slice 3 (SCHE-08, #3308) landed optional unit, weight-source and owner keys on tickets, leases and journal rows, a tolerant decoder (unknown kinds stay charged, unreadable new keys read as absent) and a protocol.json `units` gate, off by default; slice 4 retired the beep-heavy rule from the orchestrate skill and runbook, which completes PERIL-10; slice 5 (PERIL-02, #3316) makes `monitor --until-ready --detach` hand back a live readiness monitor with the same branch and readiness argv (`readyMonitorArgvKey`), keys publish's reuse on the same argv, and has `yeet ready`'s watcher hint check the runner like publish does; slice 6 (SCHE-08, #3317) landed one QualityScheduler service (admit, observe, reap, protocol gates, history, archive, route rows) with a live Layer over the existing functions, and Cache commands on their own cache kind at weight 1, written behind the units gate (gate off keeps origin/main's review-fix bytes) and kept in the review-fix class cap; slice 9 (TURB-05, implemented on perf/local-proof-force-reason) still forces every dependency-sensitive step on a bun.lock change and now also forces patch-only (`patches/` or root `patchedDependencies`) and override-only (root `overrides` or `resolutions`) commits, closing that stale-green hole with nothing else in the forced set changed; it records a `turboForce` receipt on every repair, verify and publish attempt-started row: the reasons that applied and a shadow of the narrowed decision (no force for a lockfile-only change) with, on lockfile attempts, each package's locked installed-tree digest at the merge base and HEAD; the shadow drives nothing (D14).
